meta.title: Industry Productivity & Pay Atlas — OECD STAN global plane
meta.source: OECD STAN Database for Structural Analysis, 2025 edition (DSD_STAN@DF_STAN_2025, v1.0)

measures.comp_share: Compensation of employees (D1) / Value added (B1G), current prices
measures.wage_share: Wages and salaries (D11) / Value added (B1G), current prices

meta.coverage_note: OECD countries only (no India). Employee compensation EXCLUDES the self-employed.
meta.separateness: Distinct plane from RBI KLEMS broad labour-income share; do not subtract/pool levels.
meta.prices: Shares of current-price value added (national currency); unitless ratios.
meta.licence: OECD terms of use (https://www.oecd.org/termsandconditions/); attribute OECD STAN 2025.
